gloss: to prevent; to stop; to check

definitions.gloss: to prevent; to stop; to check
definitions.explanation: To take measures to stop something harmful or undesirable from occurring. More formal than {防|ふせ}ぐ, often used in institutional, legal, and policy contexts.

examples.japanese: {事故|じこ}を{防止|ぼうし}する。
{再発|さいはつ}{防止|ぼうし}に{努|つと}めます。
examples.english: We will make efforts to prevent a recurrence.

examples.japanese: {情報|じょうほう}{漏洩|ろうえい}を{防止|ぼうし}するための{対策|たいさく}が{必要|ひつよう}だ。
examples.english: Measures to prevent information leaks are necessary.

notes:
USAGE:
A formal word used heavily in official documents, laws, regulations, and business contexts. The noun form {防止|ぼうし} frequently appears in compound terms.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {事故|じこ}{防止|ぼうし} (accident prevention)
- {再発|さいはつ}{防止|ぼうし} (recurrence prevention)
- {犯罪|はんざい}{防止|ぼうし} (crime prevention)
- {汚染|おせん}{防止|ぼうし} (pollution prevention)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {予防|よぼう}する: to prevent — focuses on advance precaution, especially for health
- {防|ふせ}ぐ: to prevent, to defend — everyday verb, broader usage
